desc:
Welcome to Hood Stories!

Hood Stories is an OPEN-WORLD city where you make your own PATH. 

💰 Build your WEALTH, HUSTLE through the streets, or play it CLEAN. Rise through the RANKS, make a NAME for yourself, and SURVIVE the city.

💸 ROB THE BANK
🚗 BUY & FLEX LUXURY CARS
💎 COLLECT RARE GUNS / ITEMS
⚔️ JOIN A GANG
🚔 BE AN OFFICER
🏠 OWN PROPERTIES
❗AND MORE

You get ADMIN in private servers YOU own! Will you rise to the occasion or stay stuck in the streets?

🎮 ALL PLATFORMS SUPPORTED! 

🔥Hop into one of the best hood games in ROBLOX TODAY!
